title: Heart failure: type, acuity and hypertension
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any related hypertension.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for heart failure and hypertension.

HPI
Pt is a 61-year-old male presenting for routine follow-up of chronic HFpEF and HTN. Pt reports feeling well today. Denies SOB, orthopnea, or peripheral edema. States he has been adherent to medications and diet. No recent changes in weight or activity tolerance. Condition is stable.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Furosemide 40mg daily
Amlodipine 5mg daily

Exam
Pt in no acute distress. Alert and oriented x3. BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 98% on RA. CTAB. Heart RRR, no murmurs. Lungs clear to auscultation. No pedal edema.

Assessment
1. Chronic HFpEF: Stable at this time.
2. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Monitor weight daily and report any rapid gains.
3. Follow up in 3 months for routine check.

Electronically signed,
K. Nguyen, DO
10/14/2026
explanations: Hypertension with heart failure is presumed linked: I11.0, hypertensive heart disease with heart failure, plus the I50 code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a causal link between hypertension and heart failure.
The type and acuity are documented: do not use I50.9.
The provider documents diastolic heart failure.
